models.reasoning: Indiana is severely shorthanded without its star Tyrese Haliburton and has yet to win a home game this season, while Denver fields a nearly full roster led by an in-form Nikola Jokic. The quantitative injury model strongly favors the Nuggets and the market line reflects this disparity. Expect Denver to control the game and win comfortably.
models.reasoning_zh: 印第安納溜馬本季主場0勝4負，且此役缺少核心泰瑞斯·哈利伯頓與多名輪替球員，進攻與組織嚴重受損；丹佛金塊則陣容相對齊整，尼古拉·約基奇近期狀態火熱並剛拿下大三元。量化傷病模型明顯看好金塊，預料丹佛將穩定掌控比賽並輕鬆取勝。

models.name: Grok
models.reasoning: Denver is the stronger side on record and scoring margin, and Indiana is missing its primary creator in Haliburton along with other rotation minutes while Denver is essentially full strength. Even rest and a possible neutral Mexico City setting do not offset that gap, so Denver is the pick by about nine points, with moderate confidence given the small sample.
models.reasoning_zh: 金塊戰績與得失分差都優於溜馬，溜馬又缺陣主力組織核心哈利伯頓及其他輪替，金塊則幾乎全員可出賽。雙方休息天數相同，即便比賽可能在墨西哥城進行，仍不足以抵銷這個落差，因此看好金塊約贏九分，但賽季樣本仍小，信心為中等。

models.name: GLM
models.reasoning: Denver holds a decisive health edge (IND loses ~45 mpg including Haliburton, DEN loses none) while Jokic is in peak form coming off a triple-double. The 'home' game in Mexico City gives struggling Indiana (0-4 at home, -3.0 point differential) little true advantage, so Denver should control this game by high single digits.
models.reasoning_zh: 金塊傷兵狀況乾淨,溜馬卻少了主控哈利伯頓(場均約33分鐘,合計損失約45分鐘輪值),而約基奇剛繳出32分大三元、狀態火熱。比賽在墨西哥城舉行,本季主場0勝4敗、淨勝分-3.0的溜馬幾乎沒有主場優勢,看好金塊以接近雙位數的分差取勝。
